summary: State the capture interface facts a fresh producer had to discover by refusal.
why: Run-02's producer spent two structural returns and two of three ontology attempts on facts the skill does not carry. Four are now in it, each behind a failing guard first. The adapter digests the reading_bytes it is handed and compares that against capture.reading_sha256, so a capture names the raw declared input bytes; a canonical re-encoding refuses at READING_MISMATCH. Every properties key and a relation's two endpoints need a formalization target, type and id do not, and UNDERIVED_FIELD returns one field per refusal. Step 3 shows a class-level grounding block on a class extending Entity directly, its three closed value forms and closed per-entry vocabulary fields, and says DIRECT_ROOT_GROUNDING_REQUIRED aggregates while a shape defect comes back alone; a guard runs that block through validate_pack_grounding at role PROJECT. The template gains an events envelope and claims only what the code admits: events need the profile bound, participations an EventParticipation type, and no bound profile refuses FAMILY_NOT_ADMITTED. Step 4 separates provenance locators from identifiers the source reports as domain facts. No subject-relation rule was added; that design is open.
